key: hi crim was here
en: hi crim was here
ja: クリム、ここに来たよ

key: ily!!
en: ily!!
ja: あいしてる!!

key: Locked.
en: Locked.
ja: 鍵がかかっている。

key: FERN: Oh, shoot--
en: FERN: Oh, shoot--
ja: ファーン: あ、しまった――

key: Just you, huh?
en: Just you, huh?
ja: お前だけか。

key: FERN: Look, no hard feelings about last time--
en: FERN: Look, no hard feelings about last time--
ja: ファーン: なあ、この前のことは水に流してくれよ――

key: Actually...
en: Actually...
ja: いや、待て……

key: No, uh,
en: No, uh,
ja: いや、その、

key: S-sorry,
en: S-sorry,
ja: ご、ごめん、

key: About last time.
en: About last time.
ja: この前のこと。

key: Even before the cage thing,
en: Even before the cage thing,
ja: あのおりの一件より前から、

key: I lost my cool.
en: I lost my cool.
ja: オレ、我を忘れてた。

key: It wasn't kosher.
en: It wasn't kosher.
ja: よくなかったよな。

key: FERN: Hey, did you have to fight one of those stupid clone things too?
en: FERN: Hey, did you have to fight one of those stupid clone things too?
ja: ファーン: なあ、お前もあのバカみたいなクローンの化け物と戦わされたのか?

key: Dunno where the hell those came from but I am not a fan.
en: Dunno where the hell those came from but I am not a fan.
ja: どこから湧いてきたのかは知らないけど、全然好きじゃないね。

key: FERN: For all my talk, I always find it hard to smile at myself in the mirror.
en: FERN: For all my talk, I always find it hard to smile at myself in the mirror.
ja: ファーン: 偉そうなこと言っといて、鏡に映る自分に、いつも笑えたためしがない。

key: And that was forty times worse.
en: And that was forty times worse.
ja: で、今回はその四十倍ひどかった。

key: "Am I always that bad?"
en: "Am I always that bad?"
ja: 「オレってあんなにひどいのか?」

key: Part of me wants to ask you that,
en: Part of me wants to ask you that,
ja: お前にそれ聞いてみたい自分もいるけど、

key: But I already know the answer.
en: But I already know the answer.
ja: 答えはもうわかってる。

key: I don't think I want to hear it again.
en: I don't think I want to hear it again.
ja: もう一度聞きたいとは思わないな。

key: I heard it enough just then, and from my own mouth.
en: I heard it enough just then, and from my own mouth.
ja: さっき、自分の口から嫌ってほど聞いたばっかりだし。

key: FERN: I owe you a few for putting up with me.
en: FERN: I owe you a few for putting up with me.
ja: ファーン: オレに付き合ってくれた分、お前には借りがあるな。

key: FERN: Whoa-- hey, hey hey hey!
en: FERN: Whoa-- hey, hey hey hey!
ja: ファーン: うわ――おいおいおいおい!

key: I don't think so-- not again!
en: I don't think so-- not again!
ja: それはないぜ――二度とごめんだ!

key: FERN: All right, end of the line.
en: FERN: All right, end of the line.
ja: ファーン: よし、ここまでだ。

key: Let's do this for real now.
en: Let's do this for real now.
ja: 本気でいくぞ。

key: MEWTWO: Twoooo...
en: MEWTWO: Twoooo...
ja: ミュウツー: ツーゥ……

key: Twooo...
en: Twooo...
ja: ツゥ……

key: Mew~!
en: Mew~!
ja: ミュウ~!

key: FERN: \PN, watch out!
en: FERN: \PN, watch out!
ja: ファーン: \PN、危ない!

key: MEW: Mew?
en: MEW: Mew?
ja: ミュウ: ミュウ?

key: MEW: Mew!
en: MEW: Mew!
ja: ミュウ: ミュウ!

key: MEWTWO: Mew-two!!!
en: MEWTWO: Mew-two!!!
ja: ミュウツー: ミュウツー!!!

key: Stone cold...
en: Stone cold...
ja: 冷たい石のよう……

key: FLORINIA: You return.
en: FLORINIA: You return.
ja: フロリニア: 戻ってきたのですね。

key: Perhaps that is only kind.
en: Perhaps that is only kind.
ja: それも、ある種の優しさなのかもしれません。

key: FLORINIA: I have been here, studying his... geological composition... as best as I can without risking damage to him.
en: FLORINIA: I have been here, studying his... geological composition... as best as I can without risking damage to him.
ja: フロリニア: わたしはここで、彼の……地質学的な組成を、できる限り彼を傷つけないようにしながら調べていました。

key: I hoped that this appearance might only be something of a shell; that perhaps he was still alive and well inside.
en: I hoped that this appearance might only be something of a shell; that perhaps he was still alive and well inside.
ja: この姿は、もしかしたらただの殻にすぎないのではないか、中ではまだ生きて元気にしているのではないかと、望んでいたのです。

key: Perhaps with the right chemical concoction we could produce a draught to revive him.
en: Perhaps with the right chemical concoction we could produce a draught to revive him.
ja: 適切な化学的な調合があれば、彼をよみがえらせる薬を作れるかもしれないと。

key: But no.
en: But no.
ja: けれど、違いました。

key: I can think of no scientific answer to solve this.
en: I can think of no scientific answer to solve this.
ja: これを解決する科学的な答えを、わたしは思いつくことができません。

key: Perhaps I'm simply ignorant, lacking in the proper knowledge, education, skills...
en: Perhaps I'm simply ignorant, lacking in the proper knowledge, education, skills...
ja: もしかしたら、わたしはただ無知で、正しい知識や教育、技術が足りていないだけなのかもしれません……

key: Perhaps if I had studied harder, I would be able to produce a proper solution...
en: Perhaps if I had studied harder, I would be able to produce a proper solution...
ja: もっと熱心に学んでいたなら、きちんとした解決策を出せていたかもしれません……

key: ...Or perhaps I am simply telling myself that because I still wish to believe that this could have been avoided.
en: ...Or perhaps I am simply telling myself that because I still wish to believe that this could have been avoided.
ja: ……それとも、これは避けられたはずだと、まだ信じたいがために、自分にそう言い聞かせているだけなのかもしれません。

key: It's strange.
en: It's strange.
ja: 奇妙なものです。

key: By all logical accounts and reasonings, Fern was neither beneficial nor pleasant to be around for much of his time.
en: By all logical accounts and reasonings, Fern was neither beneficial nor pleasant to be around for much of his time.
ja: 論理的に考えれば、ファーンは、そのほとんどの時間において、そばにいて有益でも心地よくもない存在でした。

key: Nonetheless...
en: Nonetheless...
ja: それでも……

key: I can't help but acknowledge a deep sorrow when thinking that he may never leave this spot.
en: I can't help but acknowledge a deep sorrow when thinking that he may never leave this spot.
ja: 彼が二度とこの場所から動かないかもしれないと考えると、深い悲しみを認めずにはいられません。

key: He wasn't always quite so obnoxious.
en: He wasn't always quite so obnoxious.
ja: 彼は、いつもこんなに嫌な人間だったわけではありません。

key: We had a big celebration for my 15th birthday, and everyone brought presents.
en: We had a big celebration for my 15th birthday, and everyone brought presents.
ja: わたしの十五歳の誕生日には、大きなお祝いをして、みんながプレゼントを持ってきてくれました。

key: Everyone except Fern, that is.
en: Everyone except Fern, that is.
ja: ファーンを除いて、ですが。

key: He forgot.
en: He forgot.
ja: 彼は忘れていたのです。

key: Mother spent weeks planning the entire party, and he managed to forget.
en: Mother spent weeks planning the entire party, and he managed to forget.
ja: 母は何週間もかけてパーティー全体を計画していたのに、彼はまんまと忘れてしまいました。

key: My father got me one final doll for the occasion; to celebrate graduation into womanhood, they said.
en: My father got me one final doll for the occasion; to celebrate graduation into womanhood, they said.
ja: 父はその機会に、最後の人形をわたしにくれました。女性への「卒業」を祝う品だと言って。

key: It was the very last thing to open, kept in a glass case and covered under a sheet in back of the other gift.
en: It was the very last thing to open, kept in a glass case and covered under a sheet in back of the other gift.
ja: それは最後に開けるものとして、ガラスケースに入れられ、他の贈り物の後ろで布に覆われていました。

key: When we finally reached it, we pulled off the cover for the reveal...
en: When we finally reached it, we pulled off the cover for the reveal...
ja: ようやくそこにたどり着き、布を取って中を見せると……

key: And found that the doll had been completely defaced.
en: And found that the doll had been completely defaced.
ja: 人形は完全に汚され、傷つけられていました。

key: Two hooligans of my grade had invited themselves to the occasion, snuck around, drew all over it in magic marker, and cut up her dress.
en: Two hooligans of my grade had invited themselves to the occasion, snuck around, drew all over it in magic marker, and cut up her dress.
ja: 同学年の乱暴者二人が勝手に会に上がり込み、こっそり動き回って、マジックペンで人形中に落書きをし、ドレスを切り裂いていたのです。

key: They were outed by their failure to contain their own laughter, and fled on the spot.
en: They were outed by their failure to contain their own laughter, and fled on the spot.
ja: 二人は笑いをこらえきれずに正体を暴かれ、その場から逃げ出しました。

key: Father was furious. He nearly sent everyone home then and there.
en: Father was furious. He nearly sent everyone home then and there.
ja: 父は激怒し、その場でみんなを帰らせようとしたほどでした。

key: It's fine, I insisted.
en: It's fine, I insisted.
ja: 大丈夫です、とわたしは言い張りました。

key: It's not as if I was still going to be playing with dolls anyway.
en: It's not as if I was still going to be playing with dolls anyway.
ja: どのみち、もう人形で遊ぶような歳でもありませんでしたから。

key: And so, the party soldiered onwards into the evening.
en: And so, the party soldiered onwards into the evening.
ja: そうして、パーティーは夜まで続けられました。

key: I didn't even realize Fern had left until he brought our waltz to a screeching halt by slamming the door open.
en: I didn't even realize Fern had left until he brought our waltz to a screeching halt by slamming the door open.
ja: ファーンがいなくなっていたことにすら、彼が扉を勢いよく開けて、ワルツを急停止させるまで気づきませんでした。

key: He just stood there in the entry, covered in mud, panting,
en: He just stood there in the entry, covered in mud, panting,
ja: 彼は入り口に立ち尽くし、泥まみれで、息を切らして、

key: And holding two pairs of tennis shoes, spinning in the air.
en: And holding two pairs of tennis shoes, spinning in the air.
ja: 二足のテニスシューズを持って、宙でぶんぶんと振り回していました。

key: "I finally got your present!" he boasted.
en: "I finally got your present!" he boasted.
ja: 「やっとお前へのプレゼントが手に入ったぜ!」と彼は自慢げに言いました。

key: His grin could have stretched coast to coast.
en: His grin could have stretched coast to coast.
ja: その笑顔は、どこまでも広がりそうなほどでした。

key: "What girl would want two pairs of dirty, oversized shoes?" Father scolded.
en: "What girl would want two pairs of dirty, oversized shoes?" Father scolded.
ja: 「汚くてサイズの合わない靴を二足も欲しがる女の子がどこにいる?」と父はしかりました。

key: They were twice the size of my feet.
en: They were twice the size of my feet.
ja: その靴は、わたしの足の二倍の大きさでした。

key: But of course, he stole them from the other boys.
en: But of course, he stole them from the other boys.
ja: でも、当然ながら、彼はそれを他の男の子たちから盗んできたのでした。

key: They must have had five years on him each, but that didn't stop him from tracking them both down and stealing their stupid, smelly shoes.
en: They must have had five years on him each, but that didn't stop him from tracking them both down and stealing their stupid, smelly shoes.
ja: 相手は二人とも、彼より五歳は年上だったはずですが、それでも彼は二人を追い詰め、そのくだらない臭い靴を盗み出すのをやめませんでした。

key: I don't remember a single other thing I got that year.
en: I don't remember a single other thing I got that year.
ja: その年にもらった他のものは、一つも覚えていません。

key: I wonder, did I even smile at him then?
en: I wonder, did I even smile at him then?
ja: あの時、わたしは彼に笑いかけたでしょうか。

key: If I had,
en: If I had,
ja: もし笑いかけていたなら、

key: Would he still be here now?
en: Would he still be here now?
ja: 今も彼はここにいたでしょうか。

key: ANNA: so you dragged yet another innocent person into your schemes and got them hurt.
en: ANNA: so you dragged yet another innocent person into your schemes and got them hurt.
ja: アンナ: またしても、罪のない人を自分の企みに巻き込んで、傷つけたってわけだ。

key: i guess fern turned tail in the first place this time, so maybe he was actually still your buddy in the end?
en: i guess fern turned tail in the first place this time, so maybe he was actually still your buddy in the end?
ja: 今回、ファーンは最初から尻尾を巻いて逃げたみたいだから、最後まで本当にあんたの仲間だったのかもね?

key: saw fit to save you so you could keep on putting people in danger?
en: saw fit to save you so you could keep on putting people in danger?
ja: あんたを助けたのは、あんたがこれからも人を危険にさらし続けられるようにするため?

key: but like rini said, it's not like he was actually a bad person.
en: but like rini said, it's not like he was actually a bad person.
ja: でもリニが言ってたみたいに、彼が実際に悪人だったわけじゃないんだよね。

key: come to think of it, he wanted to be a hero too, right?
en: come to think of it, he wanted to be a hero too, right?
ja: 考えてみれば、彼だってヒーローになりたかったんでしょ?

key: he only ever went down the path he did because he felt like there was no room for him, right?
en: he only ever went down the path he did because he felt like there was no room for him, right?
ja: 自分の居場所がないって感じたから、あんな道を進むことになっただけなんでしょ?

key: if it weren't for you, he wouldn't have turned out like this, right?
en: if it weren't for you, he wouldn't have turned out like this, right?
ja: あんたさえいなければ、彼はこんなふうにならなかったんでしょ?

key: did you purposely just manipulate him into turning onto your side?
en: did you purposely just manipulate him into turning onto your side?
ja: わざと彼を操って、自分の側に引き込んだの?

key: and for what-- just to let him get hurt at the end anyway?
en: and for what-- just to let him get hurt at the end anyway?
ja: それも何のために――結局最後は傷つけるためだけに?

key: FLORINIA: I... beg your pardon, but I'm not sure what's going on here?
en: FLORINIA: I... beg your pardon, but I'm not sure what's going on here?
ja: フロリニア: その……失礼ですが、一体何が起きているのか、わたしにはわかりかねます?

key: ANNA: it's the same thing that's always going on!
en: ANNA: it's the same thing that's always going on!
ja: アンナ: いつも起きてることと同じだよ!

key: lin!
en: lin!
ja: リン!

key: she schemes and manipulates and turns people against each other and then everyone else suffers for it!
en: she schemes and manipulates and turns people against each other and then everyone else suffers for it!
ja: あいつが企んで、人を操って、みんなを対立させて、その結果みんなが苦しむんだ!

key: FLORINIA: I was under the impression Lin did not survive after \PN defeated her.
en: FLORINIA: I was under the impression Lin did not survive after \PN defeated her.
ja: フロリニア: リンは\PNに敗れた後、生き延びてはいないものと思っていましたが。

key: ANNA: \PN IS lin!!!
en: ANNA: \PN IS lin!!!
ja: アンナ: \PNがリンなんだよ!!!

key: she was fooling us all along!
en: she was fooling us all along!
ja: ずっとあたしたちをだましてたんだ!

key: FLORINIA: That does not make logical sense...
en: FLORINIA: That does not make logical sense...
ja: フロリニア: それは論理的に筋が通りません……

key: \PN has been fighting Lin and Team Meteor nearly since the moment he arrived in this region.
en: \PN has been fighting Lin and Team Meteor nearly since the moment he arrived in this region.
ja: \PNは、彼がこの地方に来たほぼその瞬間から、リンとチームメテオと戦い続けてきました。

key: \PN has been fighting Lin and Team Meteor nearly since the moment she arrived in this region.
en: \PN has been fighting Lin and Team Meteor nearly since the moment she arrived in this region.
ja: \PNは、彼女がこの地方に来たほぼその瞬間から、リンとチームメテオと戦い続けてきました。

key: \PN has been fighting Lin and Team Meteor nearly since the moment they arrived in this region.
en: \PN has been fighting Lin and Team Meteor nearly since the moment they arrived in this region.
ja: \PNは、彼らがこの地方に来たほぼその瞬間から、リンとチームメテオと戦い続けてきました。

key: ANNA: that's how she gets you-- it's like a game to her!
en: ANNA: that's how she gets you-- it's like a game to her!
ja: アンナ: それがあいつのやり口なんだよ――あいつにとってはただのゲームなんだから!

key: she sets up obstacles for the joy of knocking them down!
en: she sets up obstacles for the joy of knocking them down!
ja: 障害を作っては、それを壊す楽しみのためにやってるんだよ!

key: but think about it-- an obscenely strong trainer who never talks, never really loses, bathed in arceus' power???
en: but think about it-- an obscenely strong trainer who never talks, never really loses, bathed in arceus' power???
ja: でも考えてみてよ――ほとんどしゃべらなくて、ほとんど負けなくて、アルセウスの力に包まれてる、異様に強いトレーナーだよ???

key: it's obviously lin!
en: it's obviously lin!
ja: 明らかにリンじゃん!

key: if we're not careful, she'll bring about the end of our world for real this time!
en: if we're not careful, she'll bring about the end of our world for real this time!
ja: 気をつけないと、今度こそ本当にあいつがこの世界を終わらせちゃうよ!

key: how do you know \PN didn't WANT fern to get turned to stone?
en: how do you know \PN didn't WANT fern to get turned to stone?
ja: \PNがファーンを石にしたくなかったなんて、どうしてわかるの?

key: lin could've done all this on purpose!
en: lin could've done all this on purpose!
ja: リンなら、これ全部わざとやった可能性だってあるんだから!

key: FLORINIA: ...
en: FLORINIA: ...
ja: フロリニア: ……

key: ANNA: but it's okay! i can fix him!
en: ANNA: but it's okay! i can fix him!
ja: アンナ: でも大丈夫! あたしが彼を治せる!

key: and i'll do it, even if it puts me at risk!
en: and i'll do it, even if it puts me at risk!
ja: 自分に危険が及んだって、やってみせる!

key: i'm trusting in you, florinia, and my brother, and everyone else \PN keeps trying to manipulate--
en: i'm trusting in you, florinia, and my brother, and everyone else \PN keeps trying to manipulate--
ja: フロリニア、それにお兄ちゃんや、\PNが操ろうとしてる他のみんなを信じてる――

key: just make sure you do whatever it takes to stop lin!
en: just make sure you do whatever it takes to stop lin!
ja: とにかく、リンを止めるためなら何でもやってね!

key: get ready-- this might be messy!
en: get ready-- this might be messy!
ja: 覚悟して――ちょっとぐちゃぐちゃになるかも!

key: LIN: okay, okay, we get it already.
en: LIN: okay, okay, we get it already.
ja: リン: はいはい、もうわかったって。

key: geez, for someone who was supposed to be a robot, you sure leak a lot.
en: geez, for someone who was supposed to be a robot, you sure leak a lot.
ja: まったく、ロボットのはずなのに、随分と漏れるじゃない。

key: i'm surprised you haven't cried a whole river by now, i mean look--
en: i'm surprised you haven't cried a whole river by now, i mean look--
ja: 今頃までに川一本分泣いてないのが不思議なくらいだよ、だってほら――

key: LIN: -tschrk- can we get a clean up on isle 12?
en: LIN: -tschrk- can we get a clean up on isle 12?
ja: リン: ――ザザッ――12番通路の清掃お願いしまーす。

key: FLORINIA: I... beg your pardon?
en: FLORINIA: I... beg your pardon?
ja: フロリニア: その……失礼、何ですって?

key: LIN: yeah, keep begging.
en: LIN: yeah, keep begging.
ja: リン: そうそう、その調子でお願いしといて。

key: i said we get it. sure, he was a jerk, but he was YOUR jerk, am i right?
en: i said we get it. sure, he was a jerk, but he was YOUR jerk, am i right?
ja: もうわかったって言ったでしょ。まあ、あいつは嫌なやつだったけど、あんたの嫌なやつだったわけでしょ、違う?

key: FLORINIA: I... guess?
en: FLORINIA: I... guess?
ja: フロリニア: その……そう、なのでしょうか?

key: LIN: tch.
en: LIN: tch.
ja: リン: チッ。

key: you're not gonna be winning any academy awards with that kind of performance.
en: you're not gonna be winning any academy awards with that kind of performance.
ja: その演技じゃ、アカデミー賞は狙えないね。

key: look, lady, you've got me in a bind here, okay?
en: look, lady, you've got me in a bind here, okay?
ja: あのね、お嬢さん、あんたのせいであたし困っちゃってるんだけど、わかる?

key: i've been trying this whole 'be a good person' thing that the kids keep talking about, right?
en: i've been trying this whole 'be a good person' thing that the kids keep talking about, right?
ja: 「いい人になる」ってやつ、みんながずっと言ってるから、あたしも頑張ってみてたんだよね?

key: but like, i'm almost regretting setting you up with those latis.
en: but like, i'm almost regretting setting you up with those latis.
ja: でもさ、あんたにあのラティたちを世話させたこと、ちょっと後悔しかけてるんだけど。

key: FLORINIA: You did... what?
en: FLORINIA: You did... what?
ja: フロリニア: あなたが……何ですって?

key: LIN: don't worry about it.
en: LIN: don't worry about it.
ja: リン: 気にしないで。

key: the point is, you said it yourself-- there's no scientific solution to someone turning to stone.
en: the point is, you said it yourself-- there's no scientific solution to someone turning to stone.
ja: 要するに、あんた自身が言ってたでしょ――石にされた人を治す科学的な方法なんてないって。

key: it would take an act of god to turn them back.
en: it would take an act of god to turn them back.
ja: 元に戻すには、神様の御業でも必要なくらいだって。

ja: ファーン: おい。

key: Easy there.
en: Easy there.
ja: 落ち着けって。

key: Rather than just freaking out over it, let's think about what you can do better.
en: Rather than just freaking out over it, let's think about what you can do better.
ja: パニックになるより、もっとうまくやれることを考えようぜ。

key: Firstly, to be fair to you, I got a lucky crit in.
en: Firstly, to be fair to you, I got a lucky crit in.
ja: まず、公平を期して言うと、オレは運よく急所を当てただけだ。

key: More importantly though, that was a strong showing at the start.
en: More importantly though, that was a strong showing at the start.
ja: でもそれより大事なのは、序盤の動きが強かったってことだ。

key: I can tell you really took what I said last time about creating pressure from the outset to heart.
en: I can tell you really took what I said last time about creating pressure from the outset to heart.
ja: 前に言った「最初からプレッシャーをかける」ってこと、ちゃんと心に留めてくれてたのがわかったよ。

key: Without time to set screens, I was really sweating this time, at least at first.
en: Without time to set screens, I was really sweating this time, at least at first.
ja: 壁を張る時間がなかったから、少なくとも最初は、正直ヒヤヒヤしたぜ。

key: And honestly?
en: And honestly?
ja: で、正直言うとさ?

key: I was hoping you'd pull it off!
en: I was hoping you'd pull it off!
ja: お前がやり切ってくれることを期待してたんだ!

key: You've worked hard-- you deserve that badge any day now.
en: You've worked hard-- you deserve that badge any day now.
ja: 頑張ってきたな――もうバッジをもらってもおかしくないくらいだ。

key: But I wouldn't be worth my salt even as the newest Leader if I just let you have it.
en: But I wouldn't be worth my salt even as the newest Leader if I just let you have it.
ja: でも、そのままバッジをやっちまったら、新米リーダーとしてもオレの価値がないってもんだ。

key: Nah, you lost your momentum because you hard switched into your Fire Type rather than just sacking your initial sweeper.
en: Nah, you lost your momentum because you hard switched into your Fire Type rather than just sacking your initial sweeper.
ja: いや、お前が勢いを失ったのは、最初のアタッカーをそのまま切らずに、無理やりほのおタイプに交代したからだ。

key: That's your only direct resist, so the switch damage meant I knew I could just trickshot with Sucker Punch and then sweep.
en: That's your only direct resist, so the switch damage meant I knew I could just trickshot with Sucker Punch and then sweep.
ja: それがお前の唯一の直接耐性だったから、交代ダメージで、あとは不意打ちを決めて押し切れるってオレにはわかったんだ。

key: You've gotta have a plan to deal with each of your opponents' 'Mons, and know when to let go to make it happen.
en: You've gotta have a plan to deal with each of your opponents' 'Mons, and know when to let go to make it happen.
ja: 相手のポケモン一体一体に対する対策と、それを成立させるためにいつ手放すかの判断が必要だぜ。

key: ACE TRAINER: Right, that's only reasonable...
en: ACE TRAINER: Right, that's only reasonable...
ja: エーストレーナー: ああ、確かにその通りだ……

key: FERN: Chin up.
en: FERN: Chin up.
ja: ファーン: 顔を上げろ。

key: Each time we've fought has been closer.
en: Each time we've fought has been closer.
ja: 戦うたびに、いい勝負になってきてる。

key: I really thought you had it this time.
en: I really thought you had it this time.
ja: 今回は本当にいけると思ったんだ。

key: But on the next fight, I bet this badge is as good as yours.
en: But on the next fight, I bet this badge is as good as yours.
ja: でも次の戦いなら、このバッジはもうお前のもの同然だろうな。

key: Don't you give up before then, got it?
en: Don't you give up before then, got it?
ja: それまで諦めるなよ、いいな?

key: ACE TRAINER: Yeah... You're right.
en: ACE TRAINER: Yeah... You're right.
ja: エーストレーナー: ああ……その通りだ。

key: Next time for sure!
en: Next time for sure!
ja: 次は絶対に!

key: FERN: I'm looking forward to it.
en: FERN: I'm looking forward to it.
ja: ファーン: 楽しみにしてるぜ。

key: Now go take care of your partners.
en: Now go take care of your partners.
ja: さあ、相棒たちの手当てをしてやれ。

key: ACE TRAINER: You bet!
en: ACE TRAINER: You bet!
ja: エーストレーナー: もちろんだ!

key: FERN: I'd say I've settled in well enough.
en: FERN: I'd say I've settled in well enough.
ja: ファーン: まあまあ、うまくなじめてきたと思うぜ。

key: I'm lucky that Nia wanted to move on.
en: I'm lucky that Nia wanted to move on.
ja: ニアが前に進みたがってくれて、ラッキーだったよ。

key: What do you think?
en: What do you think?
ja: お前はどう思う?

key: This feels good.
en: This feels good.
ja: いい感じだ。

key: Even when I lose--
en: Even when I lose--
ja: 負けた時でさえ――

key: No, especially when I lose...
en: No, especially when I lose...
ja: いや、負けた時こそ……

key: That one, right there?
en: That one, right there?
ja: あの子、そこにいるだろ?

key: I can't wait to see the look on her face when she finally wins.
en: I can't wait to see the look on her face when she finally wins.
ja: あいつがついに勝った時の顔、見るのが待ちきれないよ。

key: And it's gonna be the same for me too, you know?
en: And it's gonna be the same for me too, you know?
ja: で、それはオレにとっても同じことになるんだぜ?

key: That is,
en: That is,
ja: つまり、

key: When I finally come for your Champion title!
en: When I finally come for your Champion title!
ja: いつかお前のチャンピオンの座を、オレが奪いに行く時にな!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
